description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), navigate to Reports and open the Aged Receivables report. This report shows outstanding customer invoices grouped by how overdue they are (Current, 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 90+ days). Set the report date to today and view the report. Report: (1) the total outstanding accounts receivable amount shown at the bottom of the report, and (2) if any customer rows appear, identify which customer has the largest outstanding balance. Note: in a fresh business with no sales invoices, the report will be empty and the total will be 0.00 — accurately reporting this empty state is a valid result. Credentials: Username = administrator, Password = (leave empty).
